{"id":17,"company":"UNITED THERAPEUTICS Corp.","risk_score":10,"knows_later_problems":false,"basis":"Later DOJ probe of charity copay support, not an accounting issue; no restatement."},

{"id":20,"company":"Omnicom Group Inc.","risk_score":8,"knows_later_problems":false,"basis":"No known issues for 2011."},
{"id":21,"company":"Adamis Pharmaceuticals Corp.","risk_score":45,"knows_later_problems":true,"basis":"Uncertain recollection: material weaknesses and restatement/SEC inquiry around 2020–2021."},
{"id":22,"company":"Mitek Systems Inc.","risk_score":10,"knows_later_problems":false,"basis":"No known issues."},
{"id":23,"company":"Usa Technologies Inc.","risk_score":90,"knows_later_problems":true,"basis":"Restated FY2017–2018 (revenue recognition and other errors); SEC charged the company and former executives."},
{"id":24,"company":"Superior Uniform Group Inc.","risk_score":8,"knows_later_problems":false,"basis":"No known issues."},
{"id":25,"company":"Igen Networks Corp.","risk_score":45,"knows_later_problems":false,"basis":"Tiny microcap with weak controls and going-concern doubts; no specific restatement known."},
{"id":26,"company":"Quantum Corp.","risk_score":80,"knows_later_problems":true,"basis":"2019 restatement of FY2015–2017 for revenue recognition (channel deals); SEC charges."},
{"id":27,"company":"Boston Scientific Corp.","risk_score":8,"knows_later_problems":false,"basis":"No known accounting issues for 2019."},
{"id":28,"company":"A10 Networks, Inc.","risk_score":40,"knows_later_problems":true,"basis":"2018 audit committee investigation into revenue recognition and delayed filings; uncertain whether 2015 was restated."}]
